guides.title: PHQ-9 item 9
guides.message: CRITICAL ALERT: your answer to question 9 needs immediate attention. The medical and behavioral health team has been notified and will contact you now. You are not alone.
guides.action: Immediate suicide-risk evaluation by a trained professional.
steps: Do not leave the crew member alone; a crew member stays with them.
Immediately notify the medical officer and Mission Control (behavioral health).
A trained professional performs a suicide-risk assessment (in person or by remote link) as soon as possible.
Secure access to anything on board that could be used for self-harm (medications, tools).
Remove from critical tasks and EVA until cleared.
Follow-up check-ins and a written safety plan defined by the specialist.

guides.title: GAD-7 (anxiety)
guides.message: CRITICAL ALERT: GAD-7 16/21 (severe anxiety). Medical and psychological intervention required.
guides.action: Immediate medical and psychological intervention; evaluate fitness for critical tasks.
steps: Notify the medical officer and Mission Control immediately.
Assess for panic symptoms (rapid heartbeat, shortness of breath, fear); measure HR, BP and SpO₂ to rule out physical causes.
Specialist evaluation and treatment plan (psychotherapy and/or medication per the physician).
Evaluate fitness for EVA and other critical tasks; restrict if needed.
Continuous crew support; repeat the GAD-7 weekly and review the PHQ-9.

guides.title: Sleep last night
guides.message: Accumulated sleep deficit (3 nights < 6 h). Risk of errors and higher stress.
steps: Reduce critical tasks for 24 h.
Protect an extra rest block.
Run the PVT test.
Review stress / mood.
Inform the physician.

guides.title: Reaction time (PVT-B)
guides.message: Clearly slow reaction (410 ms). Limit critical tasks.
steps: Postpone risky tasks.
Take a break or rest.
Repeat after resting.
Inform the physician.

guides.title: PHQ-9 (depression)
guides.message: Moderate mood symptoms (PHQ-9: 12/27). A private evaluation with a mental health specialist is recommended and your tasks may be adjusted.

steps: Notify the crew medical officer (private).

Adjust tasks and protect rest time.
Check sleep, GAD-7 and the PVT test.
Repeat the PHQ-9 every week.
